title: 第五百五十九章 外面来了个贵客第五百五十八章 寿诞上的祖孙情
content_zh:
王龙站在街道上，看着身后排成长龙的车队，和一群群胸口绣着各个帮派不同标识的众人，心里油然生出一种天下舍我其谁的霸气感觉。
此时王龙就好像是江阳市帮派的盟主一样，身后紧跟着几天前还和他平起平坐的一帮子江阳各个不同场子的大哥，而现在，他们跟在身后，随时都等待着王龙的命令，听从王龙的驱使。
这正是王龙这几年来，无论醒着还是做梦，都期盼的一刻。
也难怪人类从古至今都着迷于对权力的追求，永无止境。
这感觉也真是太好了。
“洪，洪爷？您老……”
双喜酒家的老板点头哈腰的看着王龙身后的一个男子，诚惶诚恐的同时，目光里又显得有些迷惑。
双喜酒家所在地方，正是洪爷的地盘，所以老板只认识洪爷。
但是看到王龙走在洪爷前面，老板自然又有几分迷惑了。
“这是龙哥。”
洪爷眼一瞪，急忙先把王龙介绍了。
“龙哥好！”
能开餐厅的老板，当然也有些眼色的，一看洪爷这样，就知道王龙的地位肯定比洪爷高了，赶紧就恭恭敬敬的跟王龙问好。
“恩，你就是双喜酒店老板？听说今天你们这里有人过大寿？”王龙脸上带着一种玩味的微笑，不紧不慢的说道。
“啊，对啊，龙哥。”
老板一愣，随即答道。
他心里当然也很奇怪，这龙哥连洪爷都敬畏几分，肯定是江阳市首屈一指的人物了，而今天来这里办寿诞的那群人，看着也都不像是有钱人。
这两拨人怎么能扯上什么关系呢。
“很好，那你先我过去通报他们一下，就说有贵人前来祝贺。”王龙脸上依然是那种神秘的微笑。
“啊，是，是！”老板不敢怠慢，急忙匆匆而去。

双喜酒家虽然比不上那些五星级大酒店，但是格局占地面积也不算小。
虽然酒家的门口热闹非凡，路人纷纷驻足观望称奇，但是楼上的大包间里面，根本一点也不知道。
此时包间里，面对老太太的询问，赵思思心里乱成了线团，不知道该如何说了。
而她越是不说，老太太就越急，众人也就越期待。
就这样，整个包间里，此时所有人的注意力都集中在赵思思的身上了，所有人都在等待赵思思到底该如何回答。
搞得好像这不是来给老太太过生日的，好像是来听赵思思说话的了。
“思思，你倒是说啊，你这样我们心里真的很着急啊，我们只是想帮助你，你外婆平时多疼爱你啊，你这样，只会让外婆难过的。”张莲香眼看着女儿一直不吱声，也急忙上前说道。
“就是，你怕什么，到底是谁撞了你爸爸，你跟我们说。”张瑞杰也说道。
“说吧，不用害怕的，乖啊。”
老太太说道。
“就是，说出来嘛。”
亲戚们里，就有人开始说道了。
“是啊，怕啥啊，我们这么多人都在这里，你说出来，大家一起想办法。”
“这朗朗白日的，你不用担心什么，大家集思广益，一起给你讨个公道回来。”
众人里，也都开始劝说道。
毕竟，老太太在亲戚里也是最年长的级别的，还是有点威望的，现在这样，亲戚们当然也得帮她说点话了。
如果说一开始，赵思思的确是不想说的。
但是现在被这么多人你一言我一语的在耳边鼓励，她的心里也逐渐有了一种信心，而且内心里那种一直被压抑的复仇的思想也压制不住了。
“好，我说，是……”赵思思控制了一下情绪，稳了稳，刚要开口。
包间门就被推开了。

“老太太，你有贵客来了。”老板就站在门口，笑眯眯说道。
“什么？思思，你等一下。”老太太转向老板，“什么贵客？”
“一个身份很尊贵的客人，排场大的很呢。”老板故意卖了个关子。
content_en:
Wang Long stood on the street, looking at the long motorcade behind him and the groups of people with different logos of various gangs embroidered on their chests, and he felt a domineering feeling in his heart.
At this time, Wang Long seemed to be the leader of the gang in Jiangyang City. He was followed closely by a group of eldest brothers from different places in Jiangyang who were on an equal footing with him a few days ago. But now, they were following behind him, always waiting for Wang Long's orders and obeying Wang Long's driving.
This is exactly the moment Wang Long has been looking forward to for the past few years, whether he is awake or dreaming.
It’s no wonder that humans have been obsessed with the never-ending pursuit of power since ancient times.
This feels really good too.
"Hong, Mr. Hong? You..."
The owner of Double Happiness Restaurant nodded and looked at the man behind Wang Long with sincere fear and confusion in his eyes.
The place where Double Happiness Restaurant is located is Mr. Hong's territory, so the boss only knows Mr. Hong.
But seeing Wang Long walking in front of Hong Ye, the boss was naturally a little confused.
"This is Brother Long."
Mr. Hong stared and hurriedly introduced Wang Long first.
"Hello, Brother Long!"
Of course, the owner who can open a restaurant also has some eyes. When he saw Mr. Hong acting like this, he knew that Wang Long's status must be higher than that of Mr. Hong, so he quickly greeted Wang Long respectfully.
"Well, are you the owner of Double Happiness Hotel? I heard that someone here is celebrating a birthday today?" Wang Long said unhurriedly with a playful smile on his face.
"Ah, yes, Brother Long."
The boss was stunned and then replied.
Of course he was also very surprised. This Brother Long was even a little in awe of Master Hong. He must be the leading figure in Jiangyang City. And the group of people who came here to celebrate their birthday today didn't look like rich people.
How can these two groups of people be related?
"Very good, then I'll go over and inform them that someone noble is here to congratulate you." Wang Long still had that mysterious smile on his face.
"Ah, yes, yes!" The boss didn't dare to neglect and hurried away.
Although Double Happiness Restaurant is not as good as those five-star hotels, the layout and area are not small.
Although the entrance of the restaurant was bustling with activity, and passers-by stopped to watch and marvel, there was no clue at all in the large private room upstairs.
At this time in the private room, facing the old lady's inquiry, Zhao Sisi's heart became a ball of thread and she didn't know what to say.
And the more she didn't say anything, the more anxious the old lady became, and the more everyone looked forward to it.
Just like that, in the entire private room, everyone's attention was focused on Zhao Sisi. Everyone was waiting for how Zhao Sisi would answer.
It seemed as if he was not here to celebrate the old lady's birthday, but rather to listen to what Zhao Sisi had to say.
"Sisi, tell me, we are really anxious when you are like this. We just want to help you. Your grandma loves you so much. You will only make grandma sad." Zhang Lianxiang saw that her daughter remained silent and hurriedly stepped forward and said.
"That is, what are you afraid of? Tell us who hit your father." Zhang Ruijie also said.
"Say it, don't be afraid, be good."
said the old lady.
"That's it, just say it."
Some of the relatives started talking.
"Yeah, what are you afraid of? There are so many of us here. You can speak up and we can all figure out a solution together."
"You don't have anything to worry about this day. Let's put our heads together and work together to seek justice for you."
Everyone in the crowd also started to persuade him.
After all, the old lady is also the eldest among her relatives, and she still has a bit of prestige. Now, of course, her relatives have to speak up for her.
At the beginning, Zhao Sisi really didn't want to say it.
But now that so many people are encouraging her with words and words, she has gradually gained a kind of confidence in her heart, and the feeling in her heart has been suppressed.His thoughts of revenge could not be suppressed anymore.
"Okay, I said, yes..." Zhao Sisi controlled her emotions, stabilized herself, and was about to speak.
The private room door was pushed open.
"Old lady, you have a distinguished guest." The boss stood at the door and said with a smile.
"What? Sisi, wait a minute." The old lady turned to the boss, "Who are you?"
"A very distinguished guest, the pomp is very grand." The boss deliberately let it slip.
